summary: @or-sdk/library-types-v2 preinstall downloads Bun and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package declares itself as a Zod-based request/response type-definition library but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it in a tmp directory, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` on an adjacent 727KB file. `math_init.js` is a single-line Bun-CJS bundle carrying string-array rotation obfuscation (function performing push/shift on a large numeric constant array) and hex-numeric identifiers, with no relation to the stated types-only purpose. The use of a second, freshly downloaded runtime specifically evades Node-based static tooling: the installer's machine ends up executing an unreviewable obfuscated payload with the user's privileges at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
